title: Pantheism entails cosmopsychism, but not the reverse

statements.text: If divinity entails phenomenality, pantheism entails that the cosmos as a whole is phenomenal. Cosmopsychism does not entail pantheism, since the phenomenality of the cosmos need not be divine, and some cosmopsychists may give the cosmos phenomenality without a higher self as its bearer.

sources.quote: Pantheism entails cosmopsychism but not vice versa
It seems possible that the phenomenality in question is not divine.
